title: Harvest Processing Queue Age
dataSources: Catch trips (`outdoor:trip`), hunt map activity (`hunt:map`), foraging observations (`forage:observation`), smoker sessions (`cook:smoker`), harvest queues (`outdoor:queue`).
app: Fishing, hunting, foraging, and outdoor-cooking telemetry — Fishbrain catch logs, onX Hunt map exports, iNaturalist observations, and ThermoWorks smoker probes — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=outdoor:queue item_type="harvest" processing_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(processing_state!="complete",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by processing_state
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending harvest items backlog by processing state for post-trip processing.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside post-trip processing.
implementation: Mark each `outdoor:queue` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `processing_state`.
visualization: Table of processing state with pending harvest items counts.
grandmaExplanation: It produces where unfinished harvest items are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in post-trip processing.
